Name: Ghostly Rakun Calendars
Author: GhostlyRakun
Description:
Hi! 

Welcome to my first mod!

Well this is just a mod mostly for stark making something and practice, I think the diferent calendars look pretty good and decide to upload it!

Calendars Themes: Each one hace 5 variants, so this mod hace on total 25 diferent calendars to chose

﻿- Bat Calendar
﻿- Mushroom Calendar
﻿- Classic Calendar
﻿- Round Calendar
﻿- Planner Calendar

For this mod you need Alternative Texture and like usual. When download a new version delete old and paste new one on the mod folder.

Downloads.Description: 25 diferent calendars on my own aesthetic, some witchy, some whimsical others more profesonal.
